verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a way for users to define or schedule recurring jobs or workflows: no cron, schedule settings, or recurring refresh configuration. The nearest items are vague marketing ('reporting automation', 'on autopilot') and always-on mapping agents that 'monitor your source data 24/7'. Continuous vendor-run monitoring is an adjacent behavior, not user-configurable recurring scheduling, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
